avis.titre: The ultimate "reset button" for your skin!
avis.texte: **5.0 out of 5 stars - The ultimate "reset button" for your skin!** I’ve seen this mask all over social media for a reason—it actually works. I have oily, acne-prone skin, and this has become my go-to "Sunday Reset" treatment. You only need a thin layer, and it dries down quickly. The coolest (and slightly grossest) part is that you can actually see it working; as it dries, it pinches in around your pores, highlighting exactly where it's drawing out the excess oil. Unlike many clay masks that leave your face feeling cracked and bone-dry, this one rinses off easily and leaves my skin feeling incredibly soft and balanced. My pores—especially around my nose—look noticeably smaller and "cleaner" immediately after rinsing. It has a very light, herbal scent that feels like a high-end spa treatment. I’ve noticed that if I have a breakout starting to form, using this for 10 minutes helps calm the inflammation and speed up the healing process. A little goes a long way, so the tube lasts quite a while. If you struggle with congestion or that mid-day shine, this mask is worth every penny!

avis.titre: Amazing mask for oily or acne prone skin!
avis.texte: This mask is my new holy grail product! I have sensitive acne prone skin and a very oily tzone. On my first application I let it set for 10 minutes and could actually see the oil that was pulled from my skin. When I washed it off my skin felt softer and my pores looked smaller. The product is a little thin, but you only need a thin layer so it was no problem. There is almost no fragrance I noticed so if you are sensitive to smells this shouldn't bother you. I washed it off and there wasn't any redness or irritation, my skin felt a little tight and slightly dry but I followed with moisturizer and now it looks and feels much clearer. I ordered the sample size to try but I went ahead and ordered the full size so I can use it regularly. I can't recommend this mask enough!

I love this mask and use it about twice a week. I struggle with a bit of oily skin around my t-zone. My skin was feeling congested, if that makes sense. After using this my skin felt clean and it does not get as oily throughout the day. I’ve begun using the whole line of products and I’m no longer having ‘oily’ days.
1st time using it and its amazing! A little goes a long way! But its so expensive!!! It's definitely something I'll add to my routine every week.

avis.titre: Deeply Cleanses and Refreshes My Skin
avis.texte: I absolutely love this face mask! It leaves my skin feeling super clean, fresh, and refreshed without making it feel dry. After using it, my face feels softer, smoother, and more radiant. It’s perfect for when I want that fresh, clean feeling. I definitely recommend it!
Makes my skin feel SO clean and refreshed! I normally use it once a week for a reset and it does the job.
Absolutely works after first try! Leaves skin very soft and smooth.

avis.titre: Good mask but not for detoxification
avis.texte: It’s easy to put on and makes my skin very smooth after removal. But it does not detoxify in the way that it promises to in the advertisement. I used it twice. Both times there was no dirt rising to the surface as seen in the ad.
This feels like it cleans out my pores, love using it once a week

Con poco producto cubre perfectamente toda la cara. La sensación al momento de enjuagar después de 10 min es suave y fresca. Limpia muy bien la cara. Llevo 4 aplicaciones y si se nota como va cerrando poros.

Buy it!! It’s amazing. I have dry, sensitive skin and these were my results after just one use. I left it on for 10 minutes, then applied The Ordinary Hyaluronic Acid serum, followed by The Ordinary Niacinamide serum and my moisturizer. I’ve tried so many products to help clean and minimize the look of open pores, but nothing has worked as well as this mask. Definitely a must-buy!
Great detox mask for pores. The texture is nice and drying fast just 10 mins. Smell great without too harsh perfume.

avis.titre: Small font and no directions on the tube
avis.texte: The product is great, but the font on the tube is too small, and in addition to that there is no application directions, I need to go to my orders on Amazon to read, and as a result I don't use it as often as I'd want to. I just wrote on the tube 10 mins in large font.

I adore the Caudalie detox clay mask for my oily skin. It rapidly tightens my pores and eliminates all the dirt and makeup trapped in them. Applying it for just 10 minutes works like a charm. I use a minimal amount, only using two fingers to cover my entire face and neck, and it proves to be more than sufficient.
Worked great on my skin. Kinda happy with results but still going to test more to see further results. So far it’s great working

avis.titre: Great product for cleansing my face and cleaning my pores
avis.texte: Great Product I was AMAZED at how well it cleaned my pores, only thing after is my face is a little red and kinda feels like it’s hot. Don’t know if that’s suppose to happen so maybe won’t keep it on as long next time, I only did 10 minutes. It’s something I would try made my skin so soft and almost tight feeling.

This mask has gone viral time and time again but I wanted to see if it was really worth the hype. I first noticed the luxury packaging - the bottle is gorgeous and looks great on a countertop. While not totally fragrance free, the scent was light and clean. I am no stranger to clay masks but this product has a super smooth texture that goes on easily without being too thick or pulling the skin. The application is quick and doesn’t require much for a thin sheer layer that gets the job done. The mask starts off a peachy/pink color but lightens as it dries over the 5-10 minutes. The product dries down quickly and isn’t painful; both key points aren’t common amongst most clay masks. Overall, I really like this mask. It’s easy to use, fits into my schedule, works well, and leaves my skin visibly brighter and feeling instantly cleaner.
